name: Monte San Giorgio
description: Monte San Giorgio is a wooded, pyramid-shaped mountain rising to 1,097 metres above Lake Lugano on the Swiss-Italian border. About 240 million years ago, this was a warm tropical lagoon, sheltered by an offshore reef. Its rocks hold an exceptionally rich fossil record of Triassic reptiles, fish, ammonites and crustaceans, along with insects and plants washed in from nearby land.
